text: We said, more or less periodically every 100 milliseconds. So all the nodes that are part of the PSS, when the axis point, their axis point, since the beacon, they take that as time reference. Okay, and then from there they count: 20 microseconds, 20 microseconds, 20 microseconds, 20 microseconds, till the next beacon. Okay, and then they realign. Just in case their internal clock has shifted every 100 milliseconds, they have again the time reference sent by the axis point. So even if the internal clock is of poor quality and tends to drift, they will be able to realign upon receiving the beacon. Okay, good. So this is our first definition. We are now five minute break.
